rows.quote: These GWAS data can also be retrieved from the IEU Open GWAS repository, under accession code ieu-b-4980, which covers a population of 486,484 participants, including 11,643 sepsis cases.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the UK Biobank sepsis GWAS by its OpenGWAS accession ieu-b-4980; no dictionary row carries it.

One sentence describes the DECODE pQTL data as 54,219 UK Biobank participants and 2923 proteins, another as the deCODE database version 2021 with 35,559 Europeans and 4907 aptamers; the paper's own descriptions disagree.
